categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Standard 3-way matching process where the goods receipt occurs prior to the vendor invoice recording. Advances value-matching control integrity and works against procurement overhead.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to goal model alternative 5. Supported by frequent variants like V0001, V0002, and V0005 where Record Goods Receipt precedes invoice recording activities.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Process variant where the invoice is received and recorded before the goods receipt is posted. Helps working-capital efficiency and value-matching control integrity.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to goal model alternative 6. Supported by variants such as V0004 and V0007 where invoice recording precedes goods receipt execution.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Streamlined matching process requiring only invoice recording and clearance without any goods receipt. Helps minimize procurement and matching overhead.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to goal model alternative 7, characterized by invoice clearance without goods receipt tasks.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Resolution of purchase order items through consignment inventory consumption. Helps minimize procurement and matching overhead.
categories.rationale: Maps to goal model alternative task 13, representing resolution via consignment consumption patterns in specialized variants.
